$comment: Mode readings-route: Readings.Run.runCaseReported (formerly ve_readings_route). readings-validate, readings-separate and the S2a kinds (Readings.Run.runS2) are the readings runner's; every other case goes, with readings@1 stripped from its profiles, to the runner Compose.dispatch names (rights, soft-norms or norm-defaults, else norms; Readings.Run.runLower). The client does not evaluate Compose.dispatch, so such a row is any of those four modes' rows for the case.

candidate.$comment: Readings.Run.candidateJson: a pending candidate, or its document hash, owned and shared keys and findings.

certificate.$comment: Readings.Run.runCertificate: accepted exactly when the conflict status is certified and the certificate checks.

choice.$comment: Readings.choiceJson: per open set the choice takes a reading of, the set and the reading's index.

choice_answer.$comment: Readings.Run.runChoice: the choice, the document hash of its document, the number of its regenerated assertions and the lower route's answer to the inner case; for a certificate kind also the conflict status and acceptance. The inner answer is the lower route's row for the inner case, whose kind is not the request's, so no row shape of a lower mode selects it here: the caller reads it as that route's answer.

inner.$comment: the lower route's row for the inner case

conflict.$comment: Readings.Run.runConflict: a witness's verdict on its target with the choice its model encodes, or the conflict status the certificates show under the assumed choice.

dead.$comment: Readings.Run.runDead: whether the certificate shows the reading dead (or the readings unsatisfiable), and the finding.

elaborate.$comment: Readings.Run.runElaborate (Route.elaborateFields): the route of 1.1; past its first three rows the finding of 1.8, the stale narrowings, the compatible choices (or over the limit) and the number checked; on the superposed route also the choice vocabulary, the units of sup D, the labelled slot, the name map and the sizes. The units and the name map are compared whole with Python's regeneration (ve/readings_route.py elaborate). Under the unspecified completion (Readings.Run.runElaborateNDFilled) the row also carries fill_premises and filled, and on the superposed route fill, the Fill_T the superposed kinds append to the slot (Wire.elaborateFieldsND); under the soft completion (Readings.Run.runElaborateSD) the enumerated row also carries soft_premises.

elaborate_components.$comment: Readings.Run.runComponents (Readings.Run.elaborateOne): per case of Readings.Wire.splitCase, main first, then each companion set in source order, with the case's answer.

checked.$comment: the document the case's answer reads: the case's document, or the main case's checked part (Readings.Run.fixedPart) when it has no content-bearing set; an object (Readings.Run.asObject)

fill_premises.$comment: Readings.Run.runValidateND (UnspecifiedWire.fillPremisesJson): under the unspecified completion, per reading with content its Fill_T, each premise labelled unsaid:pair:<r>,<m>.

filled.$comment: Readings.Run.runValidateND (UnspecifiedWire.filledJson): under the unspecified completion, the chain the completion took (Readings.Chain.text; the client reads it and derives no chain), the filled frame's environment (unspecified read as deny, norm-defaults@0 removed, every unsaid__p added) and the filled units, the F_p units last.

filled_environment.$comment: NormDefaults.Wire.withUnsaid of NormDefaults.Wire.placeholderJson of the request's lower environment.

gaps.$comment: Readings.Wire.gapsJson: the filled gaps a shown result depends on (readings-defaults 2.2), each the regulated predicate, the tuple's ids and the filling's answer.

key.$comment: Readings.Wire key JSON: one generated key.

model.$comment: Readings.Run.runModel: the model's check, the conclusion's value, the first failing premise and the choice it encodes; under the unspecified completion (Readings.Run.runModelND) also the filled gaps the conclusion's value (with none, the assertions' and premises') reads.

pair.$comment: Readings.Run.pairJson: a separating situation's facts; other_value exactly when the other reading owns no generated key; gaps on the unspecified completion.

product_component.$comment: Readings.Run.componentJson: one component, its checked units, the sets it leaves on W2 and its own answer (RD-3's on it).

product_conflict.$comment: Readings.Run.productResult conflict: CONFLICT-FREE when every component is, CONFLICT when one has a checked witness

product_line.$comment: Readings.Run.entryJson: a line of the product's plan and the component it is read in (null: the document).

product_premises.$comment: Readings.Run.productResult premises: model when every component has one

product_query.$comment: Readings.Run.productResult query: the query's component's own fold, gated on every other component (4.5).

anyOf.$comment: ALL, SOME or NONE for the document
UNKNOWN: another component is not CONFLICT-FREE
UNKNOWN: another component has no model

reason.const: another sentence's readings are not all consistent

separate.$comment: Readings.Run.runCase readings-separate: the requested set and situation's pair facts.

soft_premises.$comment: Readings.Run.softPremisesJson: under the soft completion, per reading with content soft's premises regenerated on its filled tree (SoftDefaults.softXL), each labelled soft:exception:… or soft:coherence:….

validate.$comment: Readings.Run.validateResult: no content-bearing set, or one entry per content-bearing open set; under the unspecified completion (Readings.Run.runValidateND) also fill_premises and filled, and on the soft chain (Readings.Run.runValidateSD) soft_premises.

validate_components.$comment: Readings.Run.runComponents (Readings.Run.validateOne): per case of Readings.Wire.splitCase, main first, then each companion set in source order, with the case's answer.

verdicts.$comment: Readings.Run.runVerdicts (readings-defaults RD-3): on the enumerated route, the question's answer folded in Lean over the compatible choices taking assumed: the result in the form the report gives it for that question, one entry per choice with its rows and what Lean made of each piece of evidence, the labels E3 cites, the dead readings, the untaken candidates and the dead evidence (premises), and the English plan.

verdicts_components.$comment: Readings.Run.runProduct (readings-defaults RD-4b): readings-verdicts on a document with companion sets, no component named: each component replayed by itself (RD-3's answer on it), the product's result for the question, the Lean-decided units (1.10) and the English plan, each line with the component it is read in.

verdicts_conflict.$comment: Readings.Run.conflictResult (or W2's budget shape): the conflict answer.

status_text.pattern: CONFLICT-FREE among rules on the same act under every reading \(.*

anyOf.$comment: CONFLICT or UNKNOWN, with the witnesses

model.$comment: a shown model, the generator's complete model (Lean checks it extends the checked one)
a shown model, the generator's complete model (Lean checks it extends the checked one)

verdicts_dead.$comment: Readings.Run.deadOf: what Lean made of one dead reading's certificate.

verdicts_line.$comment: Readings.Line.json: one line of the English plan (readings-defaults 2.4).

verdicts_premises.$comment: Readings.Run.premisesResult (or W2's budget shape): the premise statuses and each candidate's.

anyOf.$comment: a model under a compatible choice, shown

model.$comment: a shown model, the generator's complete model (Lean checks it extends the checked one)

verdicts_query.$comment: Readings.Run.entailmentResult (or W2's budget shape): the query's answer.

anyOf.$comment: UNKNOWN: a choice without a result
UNKNOWN: a choice without a result

verdicts_row.$comment: Readings.Run.perChoiceJson: one compatible choice taking assumed, its rows and what Lean made of each piece of its evidence (maps keyed by the piece: accepted, its refusal, its shown model, its filled gaps).

additionalProperties.$comment: a shown model, the generator's complete model (Lean checks it extends the checked one)

verdicts_statuses.$comment: Readings.Run.statusesJson: each compatible choice and its row.
